gaps.description: At narrow widths the HUD drops below the controls row as a 2x2 block in the top left, so the top band takes about 125 px; the horizon at 62 percent stays clear.
Footer link is set at 0.66rem (about 9.9 px) at widths up to 640 px so it stays one line at 360 px; small for body copy, acceptable for a single attribution line.
